name: Electro-Harmonix Deluxe Memory Man (5-knob, 2 × MN3005)
description: EHX Deluxe Memory Man with Chorus/Vibrato, 5-knob EH-7850 circuit (1978-84, two MN3005 = 8192 stages, CD4047 clock, NE570 compander), positive ground on a single −15.7 V rail. Audio, LFO and clock values from the legible EC2000 reissue reference drawing (New Sensor 1995, the same two-MN3005 circuit), each checked against the 1978 EH-7850 factory drawing; supply from the EH-7850 drawing (transformer, W02M bridge, 220 µF, 2N6111 pass transistor, zener reference). Path: IC1A inverting LEVEL amp → R4/C4 pre-emphasis summed with the FEEDBACK return → IC1B ×2 → NE570 ch. 1 compressor (CRECT 1 µF) → IC3A ×2 Sallen-Key (24k/51k, 16k, 2 × 2.7 nF) → 1k/33 nF → MN3005 #1 (BIAS 1 via 82k) → 2 × 2.4k / 100k → IC3B inverting GAIN 1 (DC bias = BIAS 2) → MN3005 #2 → BAL 5k / 100k → IC6A GAIN 2 (680k in) → IC6B ×2.37 Sallen-Key (2 × 16k, 2 × 2.7 nF) → 470/47 nF → IC7A ×1.38 Sallen-Key (15k, 16k, 2 × 2.7 nF) → NE570 ch. 2 expander (CRECT 1 µF, 1.5 MΩ, 11k, 7.5k) → IC7B (−0.75, HF roll-off) → BLEND. LFO: IC8 comparator (910k / 120k) + integrator (910k; 2.2 µF chorus, 0.47 µF vibrato) → depth pot → R59/C41 → varicap 1N4001 (D3) coupled by 2 × 1 nF across the CD4047's 240 pF timing cap. The clock VCO (CD4047 + R61 + DELAY + varicap network) runs at 8–125 kHz, above the engine's Nyquist, and is the bbd clock table fitted in ngspice (notes).

sources.title: Electro-Harmonix, 'Deluxe Memory Man w/ Chorus/Vibrato EH-7850' factory schematic (hand drawing, 1978; CD4049 clock buffer 'omitted after 12/15/78'), as published by David Morrin
David Morrin, 'EH 7850 Deluxe Memory Man with Chorus/Vibrato' (single −15.7 V rail; Chorus/Vibrato switch changes the LFO cap; the depth knob is an attenuator from the LFO to the 4047 clock)

David Morrin, 'EH 7850 Calibration' (edited 8/1/78 Howard Davis procedure: clock period 120–140 µs at DELAY CW and 8–10 µs CCW, chorus just under 1 Hz with ≈ 10 % period swing, vibrato ≈ 4 Hz, NE570 pin levels, BIAS/GAIN/BAL steps)
David Morrin, 'Electro Harmonix Memory Man' overview (5-knob EH 7850 / 1343B / 7850C / EC 2000 use MN3005; CD4047 clock; NE570 or NE571 compander)
New Sensor Corp., 'Deluxe Memory Man EC2000' reissue schematic Rev. A (reference drawing 9/7/95, 2 × MN3005, NE570, CD4047, LM7915; annotated clock period 8 µs at VR4 CCW, 100 µs at CW), via SynthXL
Electro-Harmonix, Deluxe Memory Man operating instructions (controls; Blend centre = equal levels; 24 V adaptor on the reissue), via SynthXL

madbeanpedals, 'Total Recall' (Deluxe Memory Man clone) build document: BOM cross-check (27k, 7k5, 240 pF, 15k/3k3/13k, 910k ×2, 120k), ≈ 550 ms maximum delay, positive ground, trimmer functions (secondary)

Texas Instruments (Harris) CD4047B data sheet SCHS044C: pinout, astable connections (4,5,6,14 to VDD; 7,8,9,12 to VSS), tA(Q) = 4.40 RC, tA(osc) = 2.20 RC, Q = oscillator ÷ 2, RC-common protection network
Panasonic MN3005 data sheet (Xvive reissue): 4096 stages, VDD −15 V, VGG = VDD + 1, input bias −5…−10 V, fcp 10–100 kHz, 2800 pF clock-pin capacitance
Philips NE570/571 product data and AN174 (compressor/expander application, CRECT τ = 10 kΩ·CRECT, output DC = (1 + RDC/30k)·VREF)
Diodes Inc. / Fairchild 1N4001 SPICE model (IS 14.11n, N 1.984, RS 33.89m, CJO 25.89p, M 0.44, VJ 0.3245, TT 5.7u) used for the varicap D3 in the ngspice VCO fit
Headroom Wave C device research (MN3005 window, compander laws)

2N6111.note: unverified: generic power-PNP Ebers–Moll values (2N6111 is a 30 V / 7 A TO-220 PNP, hFE 30–150); only its emitter-follower drop matters

controls.label: Level
controls.note: VR1 1 MΩ log rheostat in IC1A's feedback (input gain −0.22 … −10.2). Drives the dry path too; high settings overdrive the 4558 (the OVERLOAD LED lights). Legacy 'Input'

controls.label: Blend
controls.note: VR2 10 kΩ linear between the dry node (C3/R28) and the wet node (C18); centre = equal levels (manual). Legacy 'Mix'

controls.label: Feedback
controls.note: VR3 10 kΩ log: expander output → C22 0.47 µF → R35 1k (C24 47 nF) → pot → C5 22 nF → R5 100 kΩ into IC1B's + input. Runaway oscillation near full (1978 procedure step 7)

controls.label: Delay
controls.note: VR4 100 kΩ linear rheostat in series with R61 5.6 kΩ between CD4047 pins 2 and 3: the clock's timing resistor (clockwise = longer delay, ~35 ms to ~520 ms across 8192 stages). Drives the 2-D VCO table clock.byControl fitted in ngspice. Legacy 'Time'

controls.label: Chorus/Vibrato
controls.note: VR5 100 kΩ linear from reference C to the LFO triangle; wiper → R59 7.5k → C41 2.2 µF → varicap D3 bias (node q, the clock control). Legacy 'Depth'

controls.label: Chorus / Vibrato
controls.note: S2 selects the integrator cap: 0 = CHORUS (C39 2.2 µF, ≈ 0.9 Hz), 1 = VIBRATO (C40 0.47 µF, ≈ 4 Hz). Legacy 'Mode'

controls.label: BIAS 1 (internal)
controls.note: VR6 100 kΩ trim, BBD-1 input DC. Factory: 'maximum unclipped signal'; 0.47 puts the input at −7.8 V, the centre of the library MN3005 window (−11 … −4.6 V) and the datasheet curve bias

controls.label: GAIN 1 (internal)
controls.note: VR7 100 kΩ trim; 0.64 = unity BBD-to-BBD (1978 step 5)

controls.label: BAL (internal)
controls.note: VR10 5 kΩ trim between BBD-2's outputs; factory: minimum clock residue. The engine's bbd has no clock feedthrough yet, so it only sets the OUT1/OUT2 weighting

controls.label: BIAS 2 (internal)
controls.note: VR8 100 kΩ trim, BBD-2 input DC through U2B (−7.8 V at 0.47)

controls.label: GAIN 2 (internal)
controls.note: VR9 100 kΩ trim; 0.57 makes the expander input level equal the compressor output (1978 step 5)

controls.label: Sync
controls.note: No tempo sync in the Deluxe Memory Man; stored only

controls.label: Rate Sync
controls.note: No tempo sync; stored only

controls.label: LED
controls.note: Indicator state; the pilot and overload LEDs are not controls. Stored only

controls.label: LED Inactive
controls.note: Indicator state; stored only

controls.label: Treble
controls.note: No tone controls on the 5-knob unit (filters are fixed); stored only

controls.label: Bass
controls.note: No tone controls; stored only

controls.label: Acceleration
controls.note: No such control; stored only

controls.note: No rate knob: the chorus rate is fixed by C39 / R57 / R56 / R58 (≈ 0.9 Hz); stored only

controls.label: Vibrato Rate
controls.note: No rate knob: the vibrato rate is fixed by C40 (≈ 4 Hz); stored only

parts.label: LM7915 / regulated −15.7 V supply
parts.note: EC2000 Rev. A uses an LM7915 regulator fed by a 24 V wall transformer (EH-7850 uses a 2N6111 PNP series-pass emitter follower set to −15.7 V). Modelled as the regulated DC source behind RREG 2 Ω into C_A 100 µF and R52 10 Ω / C37 100 µF

parts.label: Regulator output resistance
parts.note: unverified: small output / pass resistance ahead of the 100 µF rail-A decoupling cap

parts.label: Rail A decoupling
parts.note: unverified: value from the EH-7850 drawing ('100µf' at point A); EC2000 has 1 µF (C35) here

parts.label: 10 Ω to the op-amp rail B

parts.note: EC2000 reference network: C (bias of U1A, U3A, the depth pot, C41 and the varicap return) = −9.0 V; L (LFO comparator and integrator reference) = −7.4 V. The EH-7850 drawing shows the same 15k / 3.3k / 13k chain (unverified that R50/R51 are also on the 1978 board; it has local 300k/300k and 240k/240k dividers at IC1A and IC6a instead)

parts.label: Input to G
parts.note: EC2000 R1 2.2 MΩ; the EH-7850 drawing shows 1 MΩ

parts.label: LEVEL (1 MΩ log)
parts.note: Rheostat in U1A's feedback: gain −(22k + VR1)/100k = −0.22 … −10.2. Clockwise = more gain (the drawing marks CW); it also boosts the dry path and overdrives the stage, as the manual and the 1978 procedure describe

parts.label: IC1A 4558 inverting LEVEL amp
parts.note: 4558 on G (pin 8) and rail B (pin 4); + input on reference C

parts.label: NE570 ch. 1 compressor (pins 2+3, 1, 5, 6, 7; VCC pin 13 = G, GND pin 4 = rail B)
parts.note: Datasheet compressor: ΔG cell and rectifier in the op-amp feedback via C8. THD-trim pin 8 is unconnected on the board
68 kΩ from the R3 pin to INV IN (parallel to the internal 20 kΩ R3) on both drawings
DC feedback 2 × 68k with 10 µF centre decoupling: output DC = (1 + 136k/30k)·1.8 V above pin 4 ≈ −5.7 V

parts.label: Overload LED driver 2N5087
parts.note: unverified: 2N5087 (EHX: '2N5087 or 309') modelled with the library 2N3906; it only loads U2A through 11 kΩ + 1 µF

parts.label: BIAS 1 trim (TRIM 1)
parts.note: Wiper sets the BBD-1 input DC through R20; 0.5 = −7.36 V, inside the MN3005 −5…−10 V window

byControl.note: 2-D VCO law fcp(V(q), delay) fitted in ngspice from the CD4047B astable + R61 5.6k + VR4 100k DELAY rheostat + 1N4001 varicap D3 across 240 pF

parts.label: MN3005 #1 (4096 stages)
parts.note: Pins: 7 IN, 4 OUT1, 3 OUT2, 1 VSS = G, 5 VDD = rail A (−15.7 V), 8 VGG = R21/VR6 node (≈ −14.7 V), 2/6 clocks from CD4047 pins 10/11 (unbuffered after 12/15/78). Supply pins are not modelled

unverified: the EC2000 drawing joins R26 at the C15/R25 node; the EH-7850 drawing joins the 39k at the inverting input (standard inverting amp, gain −(39k + VR7)/100k). The EH-7850 topology is used: the EC2000 one would give a gain near 30

parts.label: GAIN 1 trim (TRIM 2)
parts.note: Rheostat: 0.64 gives −1.03 (unity BBD-to-BBD with the 2.4k/100k summing loss), the 1978 procedure's 'set for unity'

parts.label: BIAS 2 trim (TRIM 4)
parts.note: Wiper is U2B's + input: BBD-2 input DC = wiper voltage (DC-coupled)

parts.label: IC3B inverting gain recovery, drives BBD 2 directly

byControl.note: 2-D VCO law fcp(V(q), delay) fitted in ngspice from the CD4047B astable + R61 5.6k + VR4 100k DELAY rheostat + 1N4001 varicap D3 across 240 pF

parts.label: MN3005 #2 (4096 stages)
parts.note: Same pinout and clock phases as IC4

parts.label: BAL trim (TRIM 3)
parts.note: 5 kΩ between OUT2 and OUT1; wiper is the summed output (clock cancellation)

parts.label: GAIN 2 trim (TRIM 5)
parts.note: Gain −(100k + VR9)/680k = 0.15…0.29; 0.57 makes the expander input equal the compressor output (1978 step 5) with the ×2.37 and ×1.39 filter stages

parts.label: NE570 ch. 2 expander (pins 15+14, 16, 12, 11, 10)
parts.note: C16 3.9 nF on the THD-trim pin 9 (EC2000) is not connectable: lib:ne570 does not bring out THD trim

parts.label: IC7B output stage (−0.75, DC servo via R33/C21)
BLEND (10 kΩ lin)
parts.note: unverified: rotation sense assumed (clockwise = wet)

parts.label: Amplifier input
parts.note: Not in the pedal: a 1 MΩ amp input as the output load

parts.label: Chorus cap 2.2 µF NP
parts.note: EH-7850: 2 × 4.7 µF tantalum back-to-back (2.35 µF)

parts.label: Vibrato cap 0.47 µF
parts.note: EH-7850: back-to-back 1 µF tantalum

parts.label: LFO start kick
parts.note: Simulation aid, not in the unit: 10 mV at 1 Hz through 10 MΩ into the comparator + input starts the relaxation oscillator from the DC point. Centred on the switching reference (vl = −7.20 V): a 0 V kick drew 0.72 µA through RKICK and shifted both Schmitt thresholds by +85 mV of triangle (2026-11-10 fix)

parts.label: Clock-rate D3 pump (equivalent)
parts.note: Not a schematic part: the DC equivalent of the current the clock-rate swing pumps through the varicap D3 into R60 and node Q (ngspice: 55–67 µA at Q − C = 0, falling 12 µA/V, nearly independent of DELAY). The engine cannot produce it because the clock runs above its Nyquist. Fitted Thevenin: 83 kΩ to C + 5.56 V
